name: run_tests
description: Run Dart or Flutter tests with an agent centric UX. ALWAYS use instead of `dart test` or `flutter test` shell commands.

paths.title: Paths to run this tool on. Must resolve to a path that is within the "root".

root.description: This must be equal to or a subdirectory of one of the roots allowed by the client. Must be a URI with a `file:` scheme (e.g. file:///absolute/path/to/root).
root.title: The file URI of the project root to run this tool in.

roots.title: The project roots to run this tool in.

chain-stack-traces.description:
Use chained stack traces to provide greater exception details
especially for asynchronous code. It may be useful to disable
to provide improved test performance but at the cost of
debuggability.
defaults to "false"

color.description:
Use terminal colors.
(auto-detected by default)
defaults to "false"

compiler.description:
The compiler(s) to use to run tests, supported compilers are [dart2js, dart2wasm, exe, kernel, source].
Each platform has a default compiler but may support other compilers.
You can target a compiler to a specific platform using arguments of the following form [<platform-selector>:]<compiler>.
If a platform is specified but no given compiler is supported for that platform, then it will use its default compiler.
defaults to "[]"

concurrency.description:
The number of concurrent test suites run.
defaults to "8"

coverage.description:
Gather coverage and output it to the specified directory.
Implies --debug.

debug.description:
Run the VM and Chrome tests in debug mode.
defaults to "false"

exclude-tags.description:
Don't run tests with any of the specified tags.
Supports boolean selector syntax.
defaults to "[]"

fail-fast.description:
Stop running tests after the first failure.

defaults to "false"

file-reporter.description:
Enable an additional reporter writing test results to a file.
Should be in the form <reporter>:<filepath>, Example: "json:reports/tests.json"

help.description:
Show this usage information.
defaults to "false"

ignore-timeouts.description:
Ignore all timeouts (useful if debugging)
defaults to "false"

js-trace.description:
Emit raw JavaScript stack traces for browser tests.
defaults to "false"

name.description:
A substring of the name of the test to run.
Regular expression syntax is supported.
If passed multiple times, tests must match all substrings.
defaults to "[]"

no-retry.description:
Don't rerun tests that have retry set.
defaults to "false"

pause-after-load.description:
Pause for debugging before any tests execute.
Implies --concurrency=1, --debug, and --ignore-timeouts.
Currently only supported for browser tests.
defaults to "false"

plain-name.description:
A plain-text substring of the name of the test to run.
If passed multiple times, tests must match all substrings.
defaults to "[]"

platform.description:
The platform(s) on which to run the tests.
[vm (default), chrome, firefox, edge, node].
Each platform supports the following compilers:
[vm]: kernel (default), source, exe
[chrome]: dart2js (default), dart2wasm
[firefox]: dart2js (default), dart2wasm
[edge]: dart2js (default)
[node]: dart2js (default), dart2wasm
defaults to "[]"

preset.description:
The configuration preset(s) to use.
defaults to "[]"

reporter.description:
Set how to print test results.
defaults to "compact"
allowed values: compact, expanded, failures-only, github, json, silent

run-skipped.description:
Run skipped tests instead of skipping them.
defaults to "false"

shard-index.description: The index of this test runner invocation (of --total-shards).

tags.description:
Run only tests with all of the specified tags.
Supports boolean selector syntax.
defaults to "[]"

test-randomize-ordering-seed.description:
Use the specified seed to randomize the execution order of test cases.
Must be a 32bit unsigned integer or "random".
If "random", pick a random seed to use.
If not passed, do not randomize test case execution order.

timeout.description:
The default test timeout. For example: 15s, 2x, none
defaults to "30s"

total-shards.description: The total number of invocations of the test runner being run.

verbose-trace.description:
Emit stack traces with core library frames.
defaults to "false"

version.description:
Show the package:test version.
defaults to "false"
